text:
maria: Quick follow-up thread for the postmortem actions from today's multi-dependency outage. I pulled items that need owners + timelines. Reply with ack + ETA.

ajay: Ack. Can you paste the set of action items so we can triage?

maria: Sure — short list. TL;DR: (1) add cloud-region fallback policy, (2) model-registry auth retry/backoff + circuit breaker, (3) auth-provider token caching + refresh healthcheck, (4) vendor SLA escalation + contact card, (5) runbook updates + drill schedule.

simon: I'll take the model-registry item. Propose: implement client-side retry with jitter + a circuit-breaker that trips after 5 x 500s in 1m. Target: PR by Fri 2026-04-03.

maria: @simon assigned. Please also add unit/integration tests that simulate registry 503s.

simon: Yep. Will add tests and a small harness to replay errors.

katie: I'll own the auth-provider token caching + healthcheck. Plan: add TTL edge-case handling (fail-open for 30s) and a synthetic check that runs every 60s. Target: Wed 2026-03-25.

luca: I'll handle the cloud fallback policy. Proposal: route requests to secondary region if p50 latency > 300ms for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate > 2%. Implement as routing policy in gateway with metric guardrails. ETA: Mon 2026-03-30.

maria: @luca include a canary toggle and a dashboard tile with per-route failover counts.

luca: Will do.

oncall-bot: Incident follow-up ticket created: INC-2026-311. Assigned to "infrastructure followups".

maria: Vendor escalation — @vendor-eng can you confirm we've got the right escalation steps with the cloud provider and model-registry vendor? Need primary + backup contact, and SLA breach thresholds.

vendor-eng: We're missing a direct escalation to the region ops team for provider X. I'll add the contact card and try to get a manager-level SLA review. Plan to have initial update by Tue 2026-03-24 COB.

ajay: We should also track recurrence pattern — this is the third outage in 90d with auth/model-registry/flaky infra. Can we add a monthly incident pattern report to the postmortem board?

maria: Good call. I'll create a recurring doc and assign triage reviews on the 1st of each month.

simon: Small ops note: add a short-circuit path so user-facing requests degrade to cached responses when model-registry is unavailable for <90s. That should reduce customer impact.

katie: We need a safe behavior for token refresh race — I saw a case where 2 nodes tried refresh simultaneously and hit rate limits. Plan: single-flight refresh mutex + exponential backoff. ETA: Thu 2026-03-26.

maria: Add the changes to the release checklist; make them non-blocking but flagged for next minor release.

luca: For the cloud routing config, here's a sample snippet we can use in the gateway policies:

```
- when: p50(latency, 1m) > 300ms or error_rate(1m) > 0.02
  action: route_secondary_region
  guard: canary_enabled == true
```

I'll open a config PR and tag infra-dev.

vendor-eng: Also following up on contractual stuff — recommend adding an "incident credit" clause for repeated availability misses. Will draft wording by next week.

ajay: Who owns post-deploy validation? We need automated smoke tests that hit model-registry + auth provider after deploys. Owner?

maria: Assigning to eng-infra — @luca can you coordinate with infra to add a post-deploy job that runs 10 queries and validates responses within 400ms? Target: 2026-04-07.

luca: On it.

katie: I'll add healthcheck alerts to the main alerting runbook and create a playbook section for token refresh failures.

simon: One more: logging — when we failover to fallback model or region, emit structured event with reason, affected routing key, and TTL. Helps in the monthly pattern analysis.

maria: Agreed. Add a small telemetry schema: {event, reason, owner, fallback_action}. Keep it minimal.

simon: Will send a PR to logging repo.

maria: Owners + ETAs recap: simon (model-registry retries/tests) -> 2026-04-03; katie (token caching + healthcheck + playbook) -> 2026-03-25/2026-03-26; luca (cloud fallback + post-deploy smoke) -> 2026-03-30/2026-04-07; vendor-eng (SLA/contacts) -> 2026-03-24; infra team (post-deploy validation) -> 2026-04-07.

ajay: I'll follow up in 48hrs to check progress.

maria: Thanks. Please react with :white_check_mark: when you have the PR or ticket linked.

vendor-eng: Added contact card to INC-2026-311 and opened vendor-SLA-2026 draft.

katie: PR for token single-flight pattern is up in draft. Link: https://git.internal/p/fix-token-refresh

simon: Test harness branch pushed: https://git.internal/p/model-registry-retries (still WIP).

luca: Gateway policy PR opened and flagged for review.

maria: Great. Closing thread for now — we'll reconvene in the weekly triage on Mon. If anything blocks the ETAs, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
